action.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount - amount_paid) FROM ar_invoices WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND invoice_date <= DATE '2026-06-30') AS ar_outstanding, (SELECT SUM(credit - debit) FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND a.type = 'Revenue' AND g.period BETWEEN '2026-04' AND '2026-06') AS q2_revenue, (SELECT SUM(amount - amount_paid) FROM ar_invoices WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND invoice_date <= DATE '2026-06-30') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(credit - debit) FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND a.type = 'Revenue' AND g.period BETWEEN '2026-04' AND '2026-06'), 0) * 91 AS dso_days
